FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.HOUR: UTC hour from completed 1m CORE BTC bars. Incomplete hours ineligible. Never manufacture 1m from 5m.
FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.INELIGIBLE_IF: QREL_1H nonpositive or nonfinite; IMPACT_PROXY nonfinite; trailing window shorter than 720 valid hours. No epsilon repair.
FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.QREL_1H: QUOTE_VOLUME_1H / median(previous 720 valid hourly QUOTE_VOLUME_1H), current hour excluded
FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.QUOTE_VOLUME_1H: sum quote_volume over the 60 closed 1m bars
FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.RV_BUCKETS: 4 trailing quantile buckets of previous 720 valid RV_1H observations, current hour excluded, cuts at P25/P50/P75
FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.STATE: IMPACT_PROXY_t > P90(previous 720 valid IMPACT_PROXY observations), current t excluded, strict >
FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.TAKER_IMBALANCE_1H: abs(2 * sum(taker_buy_quote_volume) / sum(quote_volume) - 1). Diagnostic covariate only. Not a selector.
FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.TRADE_COUNT_1H: sum trade_count over the 60 closed 1m bars

D8.NAME: ENDOGENOUS_SHOCK_RECOVERY
D8.PRIMARY_TARGET_DEFINITION: RECOVERY_6H = -sign(EVENT_RETURN) * log(PRICE_T_PLUS_6H / EVENT_CLOSE) / abs(EVENT_RETURN), using FROZEN_RECOVERY_CLOCK. Positive = retracement. 0 = no signed recovery. 1 = full retracement. If EVENT_RETURN is zero/nonfinite, row ineligible.
PROMISING_PROTOTYPE_REQUIREMENTS: sufficient events in multiple years under the frozen support rule
sufficient return-shock matched non-high-activity controls under the frozen control-support rule
no post-hoc threshold or horizon rescue
D8.RESEARCHER_DOF: LOW-MEDIUM. One frozen joint P99-return / P90-volume shock, one 6h primary recovery, one 720-hour trailing window. Residual risk is sparse-event clustering.
D8.SIMPLE_BASELINE: RETURN_SHOCK_MATCHED_NON_HIGH_ACTIVITY_CONTROL. A control hour must satisfy the same frozen return-shock gate ABS_EVENT_RETURN_t > P99(previous 720 valid ABS_EVENT_RETURN), have the same EVENT_SIGN, be in the same calendar year, and FAIL the high-activity component EVENT_VOLUME_t <= P90(previous 720 valid hourly quote-volume). Event vs control differs primarily in the frozen high-activity condition, not by comparing P99 shocks with ordinary top-quartile moves. P25/P50/P75 magnitude buckets are not the primary baseline. Do not weaken P99 to obtain more controls. If return-shock controls are insufficient: DEFERRED_INSUFFICIENT_CONTROL_SUPPORT, not a broader control pool and not a weaker threshold.
D8.SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: Exactly one event definition (P99 |1h return| AND P90 hourly quote volume, 720-hour trailing windows). Exactly one primary recovery horizon (6h). 24h is diagnostic only. Exactly one primary control (RETURN_SHOCK_MATCHED_NON_HIGH_ACTIVITY_CONTROL). No alternate thresholds. No P99 weakening for controls. No horizon sweep. No P25/P50/P75 primary magnitude-bucket baseline.
D8.TARGET_FAMILY: Signed recovery fraction after an endogenous high-magnitude + high-activity 1h shock.
D8.TIME_SCALE: Event hour plus 6h primary recovery; 24h diagnostic only.
D8.UNIT_OF_OBSERVATION: One non-overlapping endogenous shock event hour.
D8.WHAT_A_NULL_DEPRIORITIZES: Simple endogenous high-magnitude + high-activity BTC shock/recovery mechanisms at this event scale. It does NOT close exogenous news events, liquidation events, or other event families unavailable in CORE V0.
D8.WHAT_A_POSITIVE_WOULD_JUSTIFY_NEXT: Proposal of a separately frozen event-response confirmation study. Not immediate strategy construction.
